clause_text: This Master Services Agreement commences on 1 December 2025 and continues for an initial term of thirty six months. Either party may terminate for convenience on ninety days written notice. Liability of the supplier is capped at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months, except in cases of gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Payment terms are net forty five days from invoice date. Governing law is the State of Delaware.

The subscription begins on 1 January 2026 for a twelve month term and renews automatically for successive twelve month periods unless either party gives sixty days notice before the renewal date. Fees increase by no more than five percent per renewal. The service level commitment is 99.9 percent monthly uptime with service credits of ten percent of monthly fees per full hour of downtime, capped at thirty percent. Governing law is England and Wales.

The processor shall process personal data only on documented instructions from the controller. Sub-processors require prior written authorisation with thirty days notice of any intended change. Personal data shall be stored within the European Economic Area. Breach notification to the controller is required without undue delay and in any event within twenty four hours of awareness. Audit rights may be exercised once per calendar year on thirty days notice.

The initial term is twenty four months from the effective date of 1 February 2026. Termination for cause requires a thirty day cure period. The supplier indemnifies the customer against third party intellectual property claims without limit. Liability for direct damages is capped at two times the annual contract value. Payment terms are net thirty days and late payment accrues interest at one and a half percent per month. Governing law is New York.

Confidential information disclosed under this agreement must be protected for five years from the date of disclosure. The receiving party may disclose to employees and professional advisers on a need to know basis. Residual knowledge retained in unaided memory is excluded from the restrictions. This agreement does not grant any licence to intellectual property. Governing law is Singapore.

The agreement runs for eighteen months from 1 March 2026. The customer may terminate without penalty within the first ninety days. Uptime commitment is 99.5 percent measured monthly excluding scheduled maintenance windows notified seventy two hours in advance. Data is returned in a machine readable format within thirty days of termination and deleted within sixty days. Governing law is Ontario, Canada.

This agreement has a rolling twelve month term with automatic renewal and a thirty day termination for convenience right exercisable by either party at any time after month six. Fees are fixed for the first twenty four months. The supplier carries professional indemnity insurance of five million dollars. Disputes are resolved by binding arbitration in Sydney under ACICA rules.

The processor shall implement encryption of personal data at rest and in transit, role based access control and annual penetration testing. Personal data of European data subjects shall not be transferred outside the EEA without standard contractual clauses. The controller may object to a new sub-processor within fifteen days, and if unresolved may terminate the affected services without penalty.
